conclusions: This is the scalar constant-coefficient advection equation (1.2), a first-order hyperbolic equation in the source's real-scalar setting.

q is a concentration or density, while u-bar is the constant velocity of the carrying fluid.

The equation is called the advection equation in this physical context.
